example.title: Miller homestead, house, 2913 Kansas Highway 4
example.place: La Crosse vicinity, Rush County, KS

brief: Rambling upright-and-wing farmhouse: a two-storey front-gabled upright in white clapboard, joined to a section of rough tan post-rock limestone with a steep wall gable, and a long one-and-a-half-storey side wing, all under bright green standing-seam metal roofs. Dark green louvered shutters on tall two-over-two windows; a small hip-roofed front porch on slender white turned posts with a green metal roof; two brick chimneys. Tall arborvitae against the stone, big elms and a hedge around a mown yard.
